notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting Stuff [9]': Watch Your Step, Boonta Eve Podrace, Tatooine, Tatooine: Cantina, Tatooine: Docking Bay 94, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Insurrection ('and its foil BTW'), Anakin's Podracer and Podrace Prep ('Shuffles back in'); these count toward the 60.
Posted 'Tatooine' dested the Light Premiere Tatooine system (the post does not say which printing); 'Tatooine Cantina' dested the Light Tatooine: Cantina.
Posted 'Insurrection' alone dested the single Endor Effect Insurrection (the Insurrection & Aim High combo is Reflections III, released after this post); the strategy uses it to pull a docking bay.
Posted 'Endor Docking Bay' dested Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay); 'I Did it' dested I Did It!; 'Ewok Catipult' dested Ewok Catapult; 'Melinium Falcon' dested Millennium Falcon.

Posted 'Wedge Antilles {ANH}' dested the A New Hope Wedge Antilles; 'EPP Han' dested Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol.
Posted 'Nar Shadda Wind Chimes & Out of Somewhere' dested Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes & Out Of Somewhere; 'Suprise Assault' dested Surprise Assault.
